title: Step 4 - Check Which Button is Pressed
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Detect the user's button clicks and record the clicked colour in userClickedPattern.

concepts.heading: Click handling
points: All four buttons share class btn, so $(".btn").click(handler) attaches one handler to all.
The handler is an anonymous function.
Inside it, this is the clicked element; $(this).attr("id") reads its id, e.g. 'green'.

concepts.heading: Storing
points: Declare userClickedPattern = [] at the top and push userChosenColour into it.
Log the array to confirm it builds up as you click.

task.name: Record user clicks
task.goal: userClickedPattern fills as buttons are clicked
task.expected_result: Console shows e.g. ['red','blue'] after two clicks.
task.reference_repo_path: Section 20 - Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game/script.js

pitfalls: Arrow functions change this in the handler; use function() so $(this) works.
